claim_text: Liban Yasin Alishire, previously listed in this corpus only as 'charged' in case 22-CR-222, pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud and one count of money laundering per a Hiiraan Online tracker. He claimed 870,000 meals served through Community Enhancement Services and Lake Street Kitchen, fraudulently obtaining $2.4 million and keeping $714,000 for himself. He agreed to pay $714,000 in restitution and to forfeit a resort in Kenya, an apartment unit in Kenya, a Ford F150 pickup, and a boat and trailer.
